title: Borough Style Preset file
description: One file of a Style Preset under appearance/<preset>/. StylePresetReader is the authority and refuses at the line what this schema cannot express: a fallback with conditions, a repeated family id, two fallbacks for one kind, and a preset with no [preset] table. StylePresetSchemaTests keeps the key sets equal.

preset.description: Names the preset and sets how attached Buildings share a family. Exactly one file of the preset holds it.

era_days.description: Game Days in one era. Attached Buildings on one block face raised in the same era draw with one seed.

attached.description: The block patterns whose Buildings share a draw along a block face.

family.description: The Appearance Families. A family admits a Building when its kind is listed and every condition given holds.

id.description: The family's id, unique across the preset.

kinds.description: The Building kinds this family may draw, by their Ruleset names.

weight.description: The family's share of the draw among the families that admit a Building. Defaults to 1.

fallback.description: Draws every Building of its kinds that no other family admits. A fallback carries no conditions, and a kind has at most one.

model.description: The authored model this family draws, relative to the preset's assets.

storeys.description: The storey counts this family admits. Given as [low, high], both inclusive and not negative.

frontage_metres.description: The street frontages this family admits, in metres. Given as [low, high], both inclusive and not negative.

depth_metres.description: The plot depths this family admits, in metres. Given as [low, high], both inclusive and not negative.

raised_day.description: The game Days of raising this family admits. Given as [low, high], both inclusive and not negative.

patterns.description: The block patterns this family admits.

body.description: How the family builds its body at any size it admits. Follows the [[family]] it builds; a fallback takes none.

library.description: The authored model whose materials dress the body's parts, relative to the shell's assets.

tile_metres.description: The size one texture tile covers, by part, as [along, up] in metres. Unlisted parts tile per metre.

bay_metres.description: The bay width the family aims for. A wall holds the nearest whole number of bays.

parapet_metres.description: The parapet's height above the roof deck. 0 leaves a bare deck.

pilasters.description: Pilasters stand at every bay line on the street and back walls.

plant.description: Rooftop plant units, spaced evenly along the frontage.

roof_hatch.description: A roof hatch stands over each stair stack on the street wall, or behind the middle of the frontage where there is none.

vents.description: Rooftop vents, spaced evenly along the frontage.

openings.description: Opening sizes that replace the builder's own on every storey, as [width, height] or [width, height, sill] in metres. The sill is the opening's foot above its storey's floor.

gable_degrees.description: The pitch of a gable roof whose ridge runs along the street. Omit it for a flat roof; a gable takes no parapet.

chimney.description: A chimney stands behind the ridge near the right-hand end. Needs gable_degrees.

steps.description: A step stands before each street door.

party_line.description: The body reads as two halves: a party line runs up the middle of the street and back walls and an upstand crosses the roof.

shopfront.description: A fascia runs over each wall's ground-storey shops, and an awning shades each run of street shops.

panels.description: Panel joints stand at every bay line of the street and back walls, with a floor band at each storey.

rooflights.description: Two rooflights and a vent stand over each street bay.

receiving_canopy.description: A canopy shelters each roller door on the back wall.

street_ground.description: The bays of the street wall's ground storey, left to right seen from outside. A token ending in '*' repeats to fill the bays the others leave; kinds joined by '+' take turns.

street_upper.description: The bays of each storey above the ground on the street wall, left to right seen from outside. A token ending in '*' repeats to fill the bays the others leave; kinds joined by '+' take turns.

back_ground.description: The bays of the back wall's ground storey, left to right seen from outside. A token ending in '*' repeats to fill the bays the others leave; kinds joined by '+' take turns.

back_upper.description: The bays of each storey above the ground on the back wall, left to right seen from outside. A token ending in '*' repeats to fill the bays the others leave; kinds joined by '+' take turns.

side_ground.description: The bays of each side wall's ground storey, left to right seen from outside. A token ending in '*' repeats to fill the bays the others leave; kinds joined by '+' take turns.

side_upper.description: The bays of each storey above the ground on the side walls, left to right seen from outside. A token ending in '*' repeats to fill the bays the others leave; kinds joined by '+' take turns.

paint.description: Paint schemes for the family's body. Each Building draws one scheme by its own id; a part a scheme does not name keeps its model's colour. Follows the [[family]] it paints; needs a [family.body].

weight.description: The scheme's share of a draw among its family's schemes.

wall.description: The sRGB colour of the body's wall part, as six hex digits. A textured part multiplies its photograph by it.

wall-end.description: The sRGB colour of the body's wall-end part, as six hex digits. A textured part multiplies its photograph by it.

trim.description: The sRGB colour of the body's trim part, as six hex digits. A textured part multiplies its photograph by it.

roof.description: The sRGB colour of the body's roof part, as six hex digits. A textured part multiplies its photograph by it.

membrane.description: The sRGB colour of the body's membrane part, as six hex digits. A textured part multiplies its photograph by it.

glass.description: The sRGB colour of the body's glass part, as six hex digits. A textured part multiplies its photograph by it.

door.description: The sRGB colour of the body's door part, as six hex digits. A textured part multiplies its photograph by it.

frame.description: The sRGB colour of the body's frame part, as six hex digits. A textured part multiplies its photograph by it.

metal.description: The sRGB colour of the body's metal part, as six hex digits. A textured part multiplies its photograph by it.

plinth.description: The sRGB colour of the body's plinth part, as six hex digits. A textured part multiplies its photograph by it.
